snippet.title: GreyHaT Sim
snippet.description:
Welcome to GreyHaT Sim!

Your digital sandbox for mesmerizing physics simulations, bouncing ball chain reactions, and oddly satisfying visual art.

Every animation is custom-coded to explore the beauty of chaos, kinetic energy, and perfect geometric destruction. Watch as multiplying balls shatter blocks and trigger dynamic color-shifting mechanics. See simple rules—like colors interacting and consuming each other—multiply into massive digital entropy, and enjoy the pure satisfaction of flawless physics.

Subscribe for more satisfying bouncing balls simulation videos! New simulations dropping regularly.
＼( ^▽^ ) b
